summary: Reviewed 6 of 12 changed files (6 excluded by review.exclude). Reviewed all 5 chunks (6 of 6 files). Several correctness bugs and concurrency issues need fixing before merge: a flipped boolean assignment, a missing semicolon that voids a variable, an unguarded undefined index, a race condition on totalBytes, and a risky early-exit omission. Minor formatting/consistency nits and doc gaps are also present but secondary.

findings.message: L3014: 🔴 bug: `batchRecord.used` flipped from `true` to `false` on budget-exceeded path (`fit === 0`). Revert `used` to `true` or confirm intentional with a test.
L4194: 🔴 bug: Missing semicolon after `await readFile(...).then(...).catch(...)` — `report` is always `undefined`. Add semicolon before `.catch` or use separate `const report = await ...` block.
L4625: 🔴 bug: `index` may be undefined when `values.base` is set. Guard or assert `index` defined before `buildReviewContext(index, eligible)`.
L207: 🔴 bug: `totalBytes` read across concurrent batches without a lock; race allows files past cap to be included. Track atomically or use a shared counter.
L191: 🟡 risk: `totalBytes > SCAN_DIFF_CAP_BYTES` check in `map` reads shared variable without synchronization; forward-check before actual write.
L4682: 🟡 risk: `buildReviewContext` called even when `eligible` is empty; add early return.
L4708: 🟡 risk: `projected` projection uses 1-chunk mean calculation; use running total and clamp divisor to at least 1.
L3023: 🔵 nit: `else try` without brace on same line — wrap in braces for consistency.
L3681: ❓ q: help string changed from backtick to double quotes; verify escaped single-quote renders correctly.
L4582-4584: 🔵 nit: `SCAN_USAGE` docstring omits deterministic lane costs under `--model`; add note.
L4597: ❓ q: `CREDENTIAL_PATH_RE` includes `.pem` globally; confirm no false positive on Playwright report `.pem` files.
L1984: 🔵 nit: Good security addition of `--no-ext-diff`.
L1995: 🔵 nit: Consistent `--no-ext-diff` flag for `--no-index` diff.
L4194: ❓ q: `.then(...).catch(...)` line breaking inconsistent with codebase; prefer try/catch.
L63: nit: leftover TODO/FIXME-style marker added at `tests/unit/scan.test.ts` - resolve it or link a tracking issue.
